newsitem.title: GABON: SOCCER-CROWD HALTS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER IN GABON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CROWD HALTS WORLD CUP QUALIFIER IN GABON.

text.p: Angry fans brought Gabon's World Cup African group five qualifier against Morocco to a halt on Sunday after the Moroccans took a 4-0 lead.
The referee had to abandon the match 10 minutes into the second half.
Morocco had gone 2-0 ahead within the first five minutes after a double strike by Bahja Hamed. Salah Eddine then scored twice before halftime.
Morocco were top of the group with four points from two matches. Gabon were bottom with one point.
